name: nginx-multisite
description: Configures an Nginx reverse proxy and web server for three SSL-enabled cluster-local sites, including site content, self-signed TLS, Fail2ban, firewall rules, system hardening, and optional SSH restrictions.

name: cache
description: Provisions local Memcached and Redis caching services, including Redis authentication, configuration, logging, and service enablement.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a FastAPI application from GitHub with Python virtualenv dependencies, a local PostgreSQL database, environment configuration, and a systemd service.
